name: som-shahlab/clinical_trial_patient_matching
what_it_is: A research framework for zero-shot clinical trial patient matching using LLMs, evaluated on the n2c2 2018 cohort selection challenge. Benchmarks prompt strategies, retrieval pipelines, and multiple LLM backends.
components: Post-hoc cleanup for invalid LLM outputs
measurement: Ablation across prompt strategies, retrieval top-k, few-shot count
constraints: Large models need multi-GPU with tensor_parallel_size >= 4
notable_absences: No REST API or web UI
